memberdef.name: syn_usb_midi_send_note_on

briefdescription.para: Encode and queue a Note On MIDI message into the Bulk IN staging buffer.

simplesect.para: Port-decoupled staging contract: appends a 4-byte USB-MIDI Event Packet into midi->tx_buf (midi->tx_len up to 64 B so up to 16 events batch per packet). The platform USB ISR transmits midi->tx_buf on midi->ep_in and invokes the class data_in callback upon completion to clear midi->tx_len.
SYN_OK on success, SYN_BUSY if staging buffer is full, SYN_INVALID_PARAM if invalid.
